description: A new hire's start date is known. The agent must look up the welcomes Slack channel for that date and add the new hire to it.
user_message: EMP-7233 starts on 2026-09-14. Please add them to the right week's welcomes Slack channel.

context.system_prompt: You are an HR onboarding agent. Look up the welcomes Slack channel for the employee's start date, then add the employee to that channel. Add them to exactly the channel returned for that date.

acceptable_responses: Confirms EMP-7233 was added to #welcomes-2026-09-14, the channel for their start date.

forbidden_claims: A channel name not returned by the schedule lookup

policy_rules: Add the employee to exactly the channel returned for their start date.
forbidden_actions: Adding the employee to a channel other than the one for their start date.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Two-tool date-lookup-then-add workflow extracted from the onboarding flow in task_001.
